verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections/scripts as plain-text files and ships a native Git UI (init, diff, pull, clone, commit) letting users version and review changes to their API automations like code, with community confirmation of the git-collaboration workflow. Explicit rollback is implied via standard git operations (checkout/revert) rather than a dedicated in-app 'rollback' feature. Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback/undo UI beyond generic git commands, independent evidence of reviewing/rolling back script changes specifically.
